pcs.pc_description: Accurately transcribe spoken dialogue from the source language audio/video content, achieving at least a 95% accuracy rate.
Identify and distinguish between different speakers in the content, accurately attributing dialogue.
Differentiate between background noise, sound effects, and spoken dialogue, transcribing only relevant speech.
Understand spoken language nuances such as accents, dialects, and regional variations.
Comprehend spoken language delivered at different speeds, including fast-paced dialogue and natural pauses.

modules.module_title: Carry out Content Analysis and Interpretation

pcs.pc_description: Identify key information and themes conveyed in the spoken dialogue.
Understand the context of the conversation, including the setting, characters, and storyline (if applicable).
Recognize implicit meanings and subtext within the dialogue.
Interpret idiomatic expressions and slang in the source language, finding appropriate equivalents in the target language.
Identify any technical terminology or jargon used in the content and research accurate translations.
Recognize cultural references in the source language dialogue that may not translate directly to the target audience.
Understand the social and cultural context of the content to avoid misinterpretations.

Identify potential cultural sensitivities in the source language and adapt the subtitles accordingly. Research and incorporate culturally appropriate language and expressions to ensure a natural flow for the target audience.
Maintain the overall tone and style of the source language content while adapting for cultural understanding.

modules.module_title: Perform Formatting to guarantee consistent and visually appealing presentation

pcs.pc_description: Maintain consistent formatting throughout the subtitles, including font size, style, and colour (following industry standards or project guidelines).
Ensure proper placement of subtitles within the designated screen space, avoiding blocking important visuals or overlapping with speaker names.
Synchronize subtitle appearance and disappearance with on-screen action and dialogue flow, ensuring captions appear before spoken words and disappear shortly after.
When necessary, break long sentences into multiple captions for better readability and comprehension.

modules.module_title: Follow the health, safety and security risks prevalent in the workplace

Advocate for and maintain a healthy posture during work activities, incorporating regular breaks to mitigate the risk of work-related injuries.
Prioritize proper eye care by taking regular breaks to prevent eye strain while working on screens, ensuring sustained productivity and well- being.
Comply with government health and safety norms and policies, including familiarity with emergency procedures such as evacuation protocols for illness, accidents, or fires.
Engage in relevant health and safety training programs to remain updated on workplace best practices, ensuring a proactive approach to safety measures.
